blurb: Crystal Ballroom is a spacious ballroom dance studio with over 5,000 square feet of sprung maple wood floor. They offer dance programs for recreational and competitive dancers of all ages in International Standard and Latin styles. Services include group classes, private lessons, tea dances, evening dances, and wedding dance lessons.
extraNote: No refunds on class cards or unused portions; class packages valid for 1 year · Workshops refundable before start minus $10 fee; no refunds after first class except medical with doctor’s note · No class transfers between people · Practice fees paid per 2-hour session; no open practice after 6:30 PM · Check-in at the front desk upon arrival at the studio
